Recorded claim:
`#quick-filter-bar-filter-text-bar` is hidden while the text filter is null. In `browser_filterLogic.js`, call `set_filter_text("Hotel")` before `toggle_text_constraints("recipients", "subject")`; otherwise synthetic clicks on hidden controls can land on `folderPaneHeaderBar` [Task 2]
